candidate.title: MINCE-seq
candidate.scope: The assigned Illumina middle-row MINCE-seq schematic, specifically its EdU-labeling and thymidine-chase route through fixation, biotin tagging, fragmentation, affinity capture and DNA extraction. CATCH-IT above and FAIRE-seq/Sono-Seq below are neighboring independent rows. The far-left chromatin icon and expanded name describe the target; they are not another workflow. No sequencing-library construction is drawn. Correction c_capture_material records the independently inspected full-text capture interface.

states.label: Extracted DNA fragments representing labeled nascent chromatin
features: Final icon is two blue lines labeled DNA, without adaptor or end-group symbols.

These DNA fragments supply downstream library inserts. Their genomic locations and protection-derived lengths report chromatin organization in the replication-labeled cohort; they do not sequence the associated proteins.
The endpoint is extracted DNA for downstream sequencing-library preparation; adapter ligation, amplification, sequencing, and computation are not drawn.
